========================================
Win32 qualifier macros, MIDL brackets, declaratorless typedef, guarded constructs
========================================

typedef CONST char *PCSZ;
typedef CONST STRING* PCOEM_STRING;
typedef VOID(NTAPI *PIO_APC_ROUTINE)(IN PVOID ApcContext, IN ULONG Reserved);
typedef VOID (*PRTL_CALLBACK)(IN PVOID Context);
struct S { [size_is(Length/2)] PUCHAR Buf; [default] LONG D; };
void f(IN ULONG Count, OUT PVOID Buf, [size_is(n)] UCHAR *p);
#if defined(_WINNT_)
typedef enum POWER_INFORMATION_LEVEL {
  PowerPolicyAc = 0x0,
  PowerPolicyDc = 0x1
};
#endif
struct MIDL_GUARD {
#ifdef MIDL_PASS
  [size_is(MaximumLength/2), length_is(Length/2)]
#endif
  PUCHAR Buffer;
};

---

(translation_unit
  (type_definition
    (macro_qualifier
      (identifier))
    type: (primitive_type)
    declarator: (pointer_declarator
      declarator: (type_identifier)))
  (type_definition
    (macro_qualifier
      (identifier))
    type: (type_identifier)
    declarator: (pointer_declarator
      declarator: (type_identifier)))
  (type_definition
    type: (type_identifier)
    declarator: (function_declarator
      declarator: (parenthesized_declarator
        (pointer_declarator
          (macro_attribute)
          declarator: (type_identifier)))
      parameters: (parameter_list
        (parameter_declaration
          (macro_qualifier
            (identifier))
          type: (type_identifier)
          declarator: (identifier))
        (parameter_declaration
          (macro_qualifier
            (identifier))
          type: (type_identifier)
          declarator: (identifier)))))
  (type_definition
    type: (type_identifier)
    declarator: (function_declarator
      declarator: (parenthesized_declarator
        (pointer_declarator
          declarator: (type_identifier)))
      parameters: (parameter_list
        (parameter_declaration
          (macro_qualifier
            (identifier))
          type: (type_identifier)
          declarator: (identifier)))))
  (struct_specifier
    name: (type_identifier)
    body: (field_declaration_list
      (field_declaration
        (midl_attribute_list
          (identifier)
          (macro_argument_list
            (identifier)
            (number_literal)))
        type: (type_identifier)
        declarator: (field_identifier))
      (field_declaration
        (midl_attribute_list)
        type: (type_identifier)
        declarator: (field_identifier))))
  (declaration
    type: (primitive_type)
    declarator: (function_declarator
      declarator: (identifier)
      parameters: (parameter_list
        (parameter_declaration
          (macro_qualifier
            (identifier))
          type: (type_identifier)
          declarator: (identifier))
        (parameter_declaration
          (macro_qualifier
            (identifier))
          type: (type_identifier)
          declarator: (identifier))
        (parameter_declaration
          (midl_attribute_list
            (identifier)
            (macro_argument_list
              (identifier)))
          type: (type_identifier)
          declarator: (pointer_declarator
            declarator: (identifier))))))
  (preproc_if
    condition: (preproc_defined
      (identifier))
    (type_definition
      type: (enum_specifier
        name: (type_identifier)
        body: (enumerator_list
          (enumerator
            name: (identifier)
            value: (number_literal))
          (enumerator
            name: (identifier)
            value: (number_literal))))))
  (struct_specifier
    name: (type_identifier)
    body: (field_declaration_list
      (preproc_ifdef
        name: (identifier)
        (midl_attribute_list
          (identifier)
          (macro_argument_list
            (identifier)
            (number_literal))
          (identifier)
          (macro_argument_list
            (identifier)
            (number_literal))))
      (field_declaration
        type: (type_identifier)
        declarator: (field_identifier)))))
